name: mujoco_tracking_native
description: Attach-only dynamic person-follow acceptance through the public Gateway and native navigation boundaries.

claims: exact committed tracking RunPlan and Gateway dataflow identity
exact target_id visual follow producing a map-frame native navigation task
moving scenario person remains visible while native navigation updates goals
the robot moves while follow distance does not diverge
visual follow stop waits for a terminal navigation state
excluded_claims: Product switch, rollback, and Product stop transaction
Driver stop acknowledgement or command forwarding
collision, steady-state distance, acceleration, or jerk quality
